title: Update Story
text: Update Story. UPDATE: THE COMPANY WAS FAST AT RESPONDING TO THE PROBLEM AND DOING EVERYTHING THEY COULD TO RESOLVE THE PROBLEM AND FIX THE ISSUE. I appreciate how the company worked with us to resolve the issue.  I ordered this as a gift and was shocked when I opened and was glad that I was shipped with other products so it came crossed by path before being given since I would never pass this on as a gift since the material defective. I would check the size since it is a baby blanket or for hanging on the wall.

product_metadata.title: Pavo Personalized Fleece Blanket to My Mom - There are No Words Good Enough to Express - Customized Flower Blanket for Birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas, Mother's Day - 30" x 40"
features: ✅ [EXCLUSIVE DESIGNS] Finding thoughtful gifts for your mom isn't always easy. That's why we are here to help. There's no gift that speaks "I love you" more than a blanket with meaningful messages. This super soft and cozy blanket is a perfect way to tell your mom that "Thank you for always teaching me to be strong and independent." At Pavo, our highly skilled designers always cater to your needs and strive to turn every gift idea into reality by handling each request with great care

✅ [CUSTOM TAILORED FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS] Cherish your loved one's celebrations by sharing precious memories with our customized blanket. Pavo's custom fleece blanket will be the perfect present for your parents, spouse, siblings, children, and friends on various occasions like Birthday, Valentine's, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Engagement, Wedding, Anniversary, Thanksgiving, Halloween, Christmas, etc.

✅ [MULTIPLE SIZES - MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS] Pavo's customized blanket comes in various sizes 30"x40", 50"x60", and 60"x80". Hence, our blanket can be used as sofa blanket, bed blanket, bed sheets, tapestry wall hanging, or a great addition to your comforter set. It is also perfect for outdoor activity like camping or go to the beach. Whether you want it in your bedroom for extra warmth, or in the living room for a stylish touch, this throw can keep you comfort in any space.

✅ [EXQUISITE FLEECE FABRIC] Each fleece blanket features a premium polyester print for beautiful color vibrancy, even after washing. This blanket is reversible with one side mimicking soft fur while the other is smooth fleece. The fabric is tested to be long lasting and durable while also keeping you cozy.

✅ [GUARANTEE] Your satisfaction is our first priority. If you have any issues with the product, please feel free to contact us to get a replacement or a full refund. We will try our best to accommodate every inconvenience and problem that our customers encounter with great care.
